nodes.label: Row-Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Enable RLS on every table in any exposed schema (including public by default); critical in Supabase because tables in exposed schemas can be reachable through the Data API when anon/authenticated roles have access. RLS controls which rows are visible, separate from table-level access.

nodes.label: Supabase Data API
nodes.rationale: Newly created tables may not be automatically exposed via the Data REST API depending on Data API settings; anon and authenticated roles may need explicit GRANT access, separate from RLS which controls row visibility.

nodes.label: Supabase CLI
nodes.rationale: CLI for local Supabase development with version-specific requirements (db query v2.79.0+, db advisors v2.81.3+); supports declarative schemas and imperative migrations workflows.

nodes.label: Supabase MCP Server
nodes.rationale: MCP server at https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp using OAuth 2.1 authentication; supports execute_sql and get_advisors tools as fallbacks for CLI commands.

nodes.label: Declarative database schemas
nodes.rationale: Schema workflow where supabase/schemas/ exists or config.toml sets schema_paths; edit schema state then generate migration, as opposed to imperative hand-authored migrations.
